name: Button
description: A versatile button with six variants, four sizes, a springy press scale, leading/trailing icon slots and a loading state where a spinner slides in beside the label. Renders an anchor when given an href.
a11yNotes: Renders a native <button> (or <a> when href is set) so Enter/Space and focus work natively, with a visible :focus-visible ring. Icon-only size uses `label` as aria-label. Loading sets aria-busy and aria-disabled and ignores clicks; a disabled anchor drops its href, sets aria-disabled and keeps focusability. Icons are aria-hidden. Under prefers-reduced-motion the press scale and slide transitions are removed.

propsApi.name: label
propsApi.description: Button text; also the aria-label for the icon size. Ignored when children are passed.

propsApi.name: children
propsApi.description: Custom content that replaces the label.

propsApi.name: variant
propsApi.description: Visual style.

propsApi.name: size
propsApi.description: Size preset; 'icon' renders a square icon-only button.

propsApi.name: icon
propsApi.description: Built-in inline SVG icon used when no custom icon slot is provided.

propsApi.name: iconPosition
propsApi.description: Side of the label the built-in icon sits on.

propsApi.name: leadingIcon
propsApi.description: Custom leading icon slot.

propsApi.name: trailingIcon
propsApi.description: Custom trailing icon slot (nudges right on hover).

propsApi.name: loading
propsApi.description: Slides in a spinner, sets aria-busy and blocks clicks.

propsApi.name: loadingText
propsApi.description: Label shown while loading; falls back to the normal label.

propsApi.name: disabled
propsApi.description: Disables the button.

propsApi.name: pressScale
propsApi.description: Scale applied while pressed (1 disables the effect).

propsApi.name: accentColor
propsApi.description: Brand color for the default and link variants.

propsApi.name: fullWidth
propsApi.description: Stretch to the container width.

propsApi.name: href
propsApi.description: Render an <a> pointing here instead of a <button>.

propsApi.name: target
propsApi.description: Anchor target; '_blank' adds rel="noreferrer noopener".

propsApi.name: type
propsApi.description: Native button type.

propsApi.name: onClick
propsApi.description: Click handler (not called while loading or disabled).

propsApi.name: className
propsApi.description: Additional class merged onto the root element.

propsApi.name: style
propsApi.description: Inline styles merged onto the root element.
